lines.text: Greywater, and nobody has drawn from this well in a season. The raiders ran the villagers off; their chief keeps a camp east of here — a man called Ganel.

lines.speaker: Toln
lines.text: A whole village, run off its own well. That is a new kind of small.

lines.speaker: Sera
lines.text: East, then. Uphill, in daylight, into a camp that knows the ground. Wonderful.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Rest while you can. We finish this at his camp.
